text: Job hunting is a full-time job.
With zero pay, and way too many dropdowns.
Step one: dump everything on it.
Old résumés, reference letters, that paper nobody read.
Or just hit the mic and ramble. It's a great listener.
It writes your story from that. True stuff only. No surprise PhD.
Step two: it finds the roles and scores how well you fit.

say: Goodbye, entry level, ten years required.

text: Step three: your résumé is tailored and the form is filled. Every single dropdown.

Job Hunter Agent. It does the grind. You do the talking.
